#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long modInv(long long n) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        long long x = 0, y = 1;
        long long r = n, g = m;
        while (r != 0) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            x -= q * y;
            long long temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }
        assert(g == 1);
        assert(y == m || y == -m);
        return y;
    }

    long long ncr(long long n, long long r) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        long long fInv = modInv(n + r);
        long long f = 1;
        for (long long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f = (f * i) % m;
        }
        long long invF = modInv(f);
        long long invFInv = modInv(invF);
        long long res = (f * invFInv) % m;
        res = (res * fInv) % m;
        return res;
    }

    long long smallInv(long long n) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        return (modInv(n) * modInv(m - 1)) % m;
    }

    long long normalize(long long x) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        x %= m;
        if (x < 0)
            x += m;
        return x;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < 998244353 ? v : v - 998244353;
    }

    long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + 998244353 : v;
    }

    long long mult(long long... x) {
        long long r = 1;
        for (long long i : x)
            r = mult(r, i);
        return r;
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % 998244353;
    }

    void solve() {
        long long n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        modInv(n + m);
        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mult(p, n - i, smallInv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long term = mult(ncr(n, k), m + k, smallInv(k), phaseSize);

            if (k % 2 == 1)
                answer = add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = subtract(answer, term);
        }

        cout << answer << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
